replaceMsg: ALL current TERPGRID data on this device will be deleted and replaced by the backup. This cannot be undone. Tip: create a current backup first.
mergeMsg: Records from the backup are added. Records with the same ID are overwritten by the version from the backup.
deletedAll: All local data has been deleted
title: Data & backup
subServer: Your data is on your server and, as a working copy, in this browser. Here you back up, transfer and delete it.
subLocal: Everything is stored locally in this browser. Here you back up, transfer and delete your data.
risk: Browser data can be lost (clearing browser data, lack of storage space, losing the device). A backup as a ZIP file protects your entries and photos.
storageSub: Space used by TERPGRID in this browser
persistDenied: The browser refused the request or does not support it
persistHint: Reduces the risk that the browser deletes data when space runs low – no guarantee.
exportSub: ZIP with versioned manifest and photos
unencrypted: The file is not encrypted. Keep it in a safe place. TERPGRID does not sync between devices – transfer data with a backup file.
importSub: Fully checked before anything is written
importHint: Choose a TERPGRID backup (.zip). Format, version, records and links are checked before anything is changed.
singleHint: JSON contains all records without images. The photo export names files by date taken, grow and plant.
deleteAccount: Delete all data of this account
serverSync: In server mode, deletions are synced – the data also disappears from the server and your other devices.
orphans: Orphaned links are resolved automatically during import, and incomplete records are skipped.
mergeHint: Existing data is kept; identical records are updated.
replaceHint: All current data is deleted and replaced by the backup.
contains: Contains all grows, plants, entries, photos, strains, journal, collection, expenses, reminders, saved calculations and settings – including all links.
removesAccount: Removes all TERPGRID data of this account: grows, plants, photos, strains, journal, collection, calendar, calculations, settings and the old THC calculator inputs. This cannot be undone.
removesLocal: Removes all TERPGRID data from this browser: grows, plants, photos, strains, journal, collection, calendar, calculations, settings and the old THC calculator inputs. This cannot be undone.
storageServer: Data storage: on your TERPGRID server (encrypted, AES-256-GCM – the operator could technically decrypt) and as a working copy in this browser’s IndexedDB (unencrypted, separated per account). THC Lab inputs stay in this device’s localStorage. Discover requests go through your server; providers receive no personal data. A full export is available under Account → Data.
storageLocal: Data storage: IndexedDB (records & photos) and localStorage (THC Lab inputs). Data is tied to this browser on this device, is not synced, not stored encrypted and never sent to a server. The exception is searches in Discover: they go to the external strain data providers; cached responses are stored locally and are not part of the backup.
willDelete: {g} grows, {p} plants, {f} photos and all other data will be permanently deleted.
